extraction.name: CIFAR-10
extraction.description: The CIFAR-10 dataset contains 60,000 32x32 color images, each labeled as one of ten classes. It is divided into a training set of 50,000 images and a validation set of 10,000 images.
extraction.creator: Alex Krizhevsky, Vinod Nair, Geoffrey Hinton
extraction.citeAs: Alex Krizhevsky, Vinod Nair, and Geoffrey Hinton. Cifar-100 and cifar-10 (canadian institute for advanced research), 2009.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: We normalize using CIFAR_MEAN and CIFAR_STD. For data augmentation we use random horizontal flipping alongside 2-pixel random translation. For translation we use reflection padding. We initialize the first convolutional layer as a patch-whitening transformation.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: 94% is the level of human accuracy reported by Karpathy (2011).
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Facilitating thousands of research projects per year; accelerating the experimental iteration time of researchers; decreasing the cost of projects involving a massive number of trained networks; rapid accumulation of statistical significance for subtle hyperparameter comparisons.
